strings.name: Philip Dybvig
strings.summary: With Douglas Diamond, Dybvig modeled how bank maturity transformation supplies liquidity while creating run risk, sharing the 2022 economics Nobel. In 2026 he moved from WashU to SWUFE. Students alleged sexual harassment in 2022; his lawyer disputed the claims. A 2025 student-newspaper report said the university had not publicly explained its investigation.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-developed the bank-run model, explaining deposit insurance and financial-stability mechanisms.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Indiana mathematics and physics BA (1976); Yale economics PhD (1979).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Bank-liquidity model
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Diamond, analyzed deposits, long-term investment, runs and deposit insurance.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Financial theory and education
strings.highlights.h2.text: Studies pricing and portfolios and has long participated in Chinese finance education.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Moved to SWUFE
strings.timeline.t1.text: Became University Professor in July and a visiting scholar at the St. Louis Fed.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Investigation-transparency report
strings.timeline.t2.text: Student newspaper said the university had not publicly explained the inquiry; his lawyer had rejected the 2022 claims.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Shared economics Nobel
strings.timeline.t3.text: Won with Bernanke and Douglas Diamond for banks and financial crises.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Led financial research institute
strings.timeline.t4.text: Began directing SWUFE’s institute, a role lasting until 2021.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Permanent WashU appointment
strings.timeline.t5.text: After visiting in 1988, became John E. Simon Professor of Finance.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Bank-run model published
strings.timeline.t6.text: With Douglas Diamond, published banking-liquidity research in the Journal of Political Economy.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined Yale management faculty
strings.timeline.t7.text: Moved from Princeton as assistant professor of finance.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Economics doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Studied with Stephen Ross at Yale before teaching at Princeton.
strings.timeline.t9.title: Completed mathematics and physics degree
